text:
priya: heads up — we're seeing a ~0.9% 413 spike on /v1/embeddings in prod since yesterday evening. appears correlated to mixed-dim payloads that also exceed ~50KB payload size. stack: ingress preflight -> splitter -> router.

jordan: ugh. any sample request we can repro with? quick sanity: are these 413s coming from our ingress (nginx/edge) or runtime chunking?

priya: posted a trimmed curl in #eng-runtime but here's the core reproduce: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
 -H "X-Embed-Dims: 1536,768,1536" 
 -d '{"input": ["long text...", "short text", "another long text..."]}'
```
most clients send mixed dims and a single large array -> splitter trips -> we see 413 from runtime before splitter emits OK.

sam: iirc splitter assumes max-bytes per route, but if dims differ we do per-dim routing which can temporarily reframe the payload. could be double-counting bytes in preflight. logging?

ingest-bot: preflight-checker: 2026-03-19T03:12:11Z route=embed-ingress status=413 reason=payload_too_large payload_bytes=55234 dims_hint=[1536,768,1536] client=tenant-42

kai: console telemetry shows an uptick in `embed_request_errors.rate` for tenant-42 around 03:10Z, with grouping by `preflight_stage=ingress` and `splitter_result=oversize`. bucketed mostly at 50-70KB.

priya: thinking out loud: options — 1) tighten preflight on ingress and return a friendlier client error with a hint to split; 2) adjust splitter to proactively chunk before hitting size limit (fastpath); 3) change routing policy to prefer small-chunk fastpath for mixed dims; 4) add console alerting + UX hint to show tenant-side examples.

jordan: (2) seems user-friendly but risky w/o canary — splitter changes touch runtime hot path. we could ship (1) quickly and pair with a console CTA that shows suggested `split` examples.

sam: +1 on canary for (2). Also want to verify if header `X-Embed-Dims` is authoritative or advisory — clients may omit it and we infer dims on infer node which changes preflight. ambiguous semantics here cause mismatch between console guidance and runtime behavior.

priya: good call. we should document that header is advisory and preflight will re-evaluate, but we also need a consistent console display. propose: add `preflight.dim_estimate` telemetry and show on request details page in console.

kai: i can wire a dashboard panel showing `preflight.dim_estimate` vs `client_header_dims` and a small percent of mismatches. that will help product message.

console-team: we could add a quick-fix CTA in the route page: "Try splitting your request" that opens a snippet with `for` loop + chunking example using our SDK. keeps friction low.

priya: implementation plan: short term -> return explicit 413 message with JSON body {"error":"payload_too_large","hint":"try splitting inputs; see console route page for examples"} and add server-side telemetry. medium -> canary splitter improvement that proactively pre-chunks mixed-dim large payloads. long -> server-side adaptive router that routes by bytes+dims with soft-throttle.

jordan: agree. please also add a temporary quota rule that prevents noisy tenants from triggering splinter storms — maybe a per-tenant preflight-rate-limit.

sam: note for canary: add unit test for mixed dims with many small+one huge element; test coverage for preflight->splitter race.

priya: i'll open a PR for the 413 message update + telemetry and a console ticket for the CTA. tagging @console-team and @eng-runtime for reviews. :eyes:

ingest-bot: ticket created: EMB-1219 preflight friendly 413 + telemetry -> https://issues.redwood.ai/EMB-1219

jordan: thx — once PR is up i'll run a small canary against staging with tenant-42's sample data. if stable we can roll to a subset of prod. :shipit:

sam: and reminder — update our docs/SDK README with the recommended client-side chunking patterns, and maybe add an `embed_chunker` helper in the Python SDK.

priya: noted. will include SDK snippet in the console CTA ticket.

console-team: will mock CTA UI this afternoon, will post the mock here for quick feedback.

priya: cool. closing the loop: immediate actions: PR for 413+telemetry, console CTA ticket, dashboard panel from kai, canary plan after PR. i'll follow up with timelines in EMB-1219. :+1:
